mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.email, u.name, u.created_at, u.updated_at, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM users u LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = u.user_id AND t.target_type = 'USER' AND t.target_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (login_id, email, name, password_hash) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{email}, #{name}, #{passwordHash})
